title: DOCOM CertificateUpdated event (v1)
description: Event emitted when a TRACES DOCOM certificate snapshot is observed or republished. Certificate aggregate; subType is DOCOM. data is the full DOCOM profile and may include optional followUp[] when TRACES returned Part III records alongside the certificate. Append-only follow-up changes without a certificate reissue are also published as CertificateFollowUpUpdated (see docom-event-followup-updated-v1).
